shortBio.en: 1960s blues-rock lab; guitar-hero pipeline out of London clubs.
shortBio.zh: 1960 年代蓝调摇滚实验室；伦敦俱乐部输出的吉他英雄管道。

body.en:
Formed 1963 in London. Early hits (For Your Love, 1965) and the Beck/Page eras document feedback, rave-ups, and studio experimentation beyond strict blues covers.

Bridge page in the person graph: Clapton exits to Cream; Page carries unfinished business into Led Zeppelin. Catalog is secondary to the personnel flow it enabled.
body.zh:
1963 年于伦敦组建。早期热单（For Your Love，1965）与 Beck/Page 时期记录反馈、rave-up 与超出严格蓝调翻唱的录音室实验。

人物图谱桥页：Clapton 离队组建 Cream；Page 把未完成事务带进 Led Zeppelin。目录次要于它所促成的人事流动。

whyMatters.en: British R&B band that successively featured Clapton, Beck, and Page—personnel lab whose guitarists fed Cream and Led Zeppelin.
whyMatters.zh: 英国 R&B 乐队：相继拥有 Clapton、Beck、Page——吉他手分别流向 Cream 与 Led Zeppelin 的人事实验室。

note.en: Harpsichord pop single that pushed Clapton toward blues-purist exit.
note.zh: 羽管键琴流行单曲把 Clapton 推向蓝调纯粹主义者离队。

note.en: Beck's fuzz-tone sitar substitute on a minor-key riff.
note.zh: Beck 用 fuzz 音色替代 sitar 的小调 riff。

note.en: Feedback swells and anti-war lyric—proto-psych in a 2:30 single.
note.zh: 反馈延音与反战歌词——2:30 单曲里的前迷幻。

title.zh: Clapton 蓝调纯粹主义时期

body.en:
The Yardbirds start as a Crawdaddy Club R&B unit covering Chicago blues. Clapton's guitar hero status builds on extended live rave-ups.

For Your Love (1965) adds harpsichord and pop arrangement—Clapton leaves March 1965 citing commercial drift.

His exit opens the Beck chair; the band's function as guitar incubator begins.
body.zh:
Yardbirds 起步于 Crawdaddy Club R&B 单位，翻唱芝加哥蓝调。Clapton 吉他英雄地位建立在延长现场 rave-up 上。

For Your Love（1965）加入羽管键琴与流行编曲——Clapton 1965 年 3 月因商业化离队。

他的空缺开启 Beck 席位；乐队作为吉他孵化器的功能启动。

body.en:
Jeff Beck replaces Clapton mid-1965. Heart Full of Soul uses fuzz in place of sitar; Shapes of Things adds controlled feedback swells.

Roger the Engineer (1966, US: Over Under Sideways Down) is the Beck peak—Indian scales, reverse tape, and rave-up closers.

Beck departs after US tour friction; Page already in the band switches to lead guitar.
body.zh:
Jeff Beck 1965 年中接替 Clapton。Heart Full of Soul 用 fuzz 替 sitar；Shapes of Things 加可控反馈延音。

Roger the Engineer（1966，美版 Over Under Sideways Down）是 Beck 巅峰——印度音阶、反向磁带与 rave-up 收尾。

Beck 在美巡摩擦后离队；已在队的 Page 转任主音吉他。

body.en:
Jimmy Page joins initially on bass, then lead after Beck exits. Dual-lead experiments with Chris Dreja on guitar precede the final quartet.

Little Games (1967) is a commercial detour; live sets still feature extended blues jams and Dazed and Confused prototypes.

Band dissolves 1968; Page retains touring obligations and forms Led Zeppelin from the remaining dates.
body.zh:
Jimmy Page 先入队贝斯，Beck 离队后转主音。与 Chris Dreja 双主音实验后定型四人组。

Little Games（1967）是商业岔路；现场仍含延长蓝调 jam 与 Dazed and Confused 原型。

乐队 1968 年解散；Page 保留巡演义务并从未完成场次中组建 Led Zeppelin。
